starting_state: A domain or plan author selects or supplies a source set, a plan needs semantic references, source drift is detected, or a projection is requested.
preconditions: referenced concepts, policies, units, relations, environments, and projection adapters can be resolved and versioned.
intention: Bind work to validated, reproducible domain meaning before authority or execution can spend it.
job: Supply, validate, inspect, pin, and project a `.sea` model while keeping derived output subordinate to source.
authority_requirements: Attributable actor context and role resolution
Policy digest binding against active snapshot
expected_consequential_state_transitions: Supplied source becomes validated or rejected
a plan moves from unresolved to semantically pinned
projection output becomes validated and hash-linked or quarantined.
settlement_condition: All semantic references resolve against an exact validated model and adapter snapshot, or activation remains blocked with layer-specific diagnostics and a lawful repair path.
expected_next_decisions_and_affordances: Pin the model to a case
or quarantine and rework invalid output.
applicable_failure_and_recovery_behavior: Correct syntax, import, identity, policy, unit, relation, or mapping failures at their actual layer
quarantine invalid projections without changing source truth.
expected_unavailable_states: complete visual domain model browser is preview-only (/models shows specification preview)
